steps.name: join with enzyme
steps.note: The enzyme is taken from the microbe Bacillus circulans in the original grade; in newer grades it is made by the microbe Pichia pastoris, carrying a gene from Sporobolomyces singularis (Vivinal GOS B) or Papiliotrema terrestris (Vivinal GOS PT).
